q: A person crosses a 500m road in 5 minutes. Find his speed in km/hr.
If a person walks at 12km/hr instead of 10km/hr, he covers 20km more (same time). Find the actual distance covered.
Rahul travels 12m/sec. Find the distance (km) he covers in 3hr45min.
A plane covers 980km in 35 minutes. Find the time for 1470km.
A person covers a distance in 3hr36min at 5km/hr. Find the time by bicycle at 24km/hr.
A train's speed is 72km/hr. Find the distance covered in 10min35sec.
A plane covers a distance in 14hr at 210km/hr. Find the required speed to cover it in 9hr48min.
A car travels 80km in 2hr; a train travels 180km in 3hr. Find the ratio of car's to train's speed.
Distance between 2 stations=1600km, covered in 10hr. Find the train's speed.
Two buses travel at 45,60km/hr. The second bus takes 5.5hr less than the first for the same distance. Find the distance.
A person reduces speed by 25km/hr and arrives 12.5min late. If his initial speed was 160km/hr, find the distance.
A cyclist covers 15km in 20min. If speed increases by 3km/hr, find the new time.
A car covers 60.48km using 5.4L petrol. Find the distance covered with 22L.
Distance between two cities covered in 3hr15min at 52km/hr. If speed increases to 65km/hr, find the time saved.
Two cars start from the same point at right angles, speeds 36,48km/hr. Find the distance between them after 15 seconds.
A map scale: 0.5cm represents 300km. If two cities are 900km apart, find the map distance.
A farmer travels 61km in 9hr, partly walking (4km/hr) and partly cycling (9km/hr). Find the walking distance.
Aman walks uphill at 4mph and downhill at 5mph, covering 85 miles total in 19 hours. Find the downhill distance.
A person walks 1km on day 1, 2km on day 2, 3km on day 3, and so on. Find the total distance in 10 days.
A car's speed increases by 2km/hr each hour; first-hour distance=35km. Find the total distance in 12 hours.
X,Y travel in the same direction at 15,12km/hr. Y's speed increases by 0.5km/hr each hour. Find when they meet.
Traveling at 40km/hr gets someone to their destination on time. If they cover 2/3 of the distance in 1/3 of the time, find the speed needed for the rest to stay on time.
A car covers 35% of a distance in 30% of the time, 45% in 60% of the time. At normal speed 60km/hr, find the speed needed for the rest to arrive early.
Ankit,Kuldeep travel Ranchi to Patna at 40,64km/hr. Kuldeep starts 61min after Ankit but arrives 29min before him. Find the distance.
At 50km/hr a person is 20min late; at 60km/hr, 10min early. Find the distance.
Aman travels a distance at 25km/hr and returns at 4km/hr, total time 5hr48min. Find the distance.
Travel between stations takes 7hr. If speed is reduced by 14km/hr, it takes 50min more. Find the distance.
sol: Solve quadratic for speed s≈131.6 → D=7s≈921km

q: Time difference for two trains covering 450km is 1hr30min; speed difference is 15km/hr. Find the slower train's speed.
Sameer drove to a resort at 81km/hr; the return trip (traffic) took 56min more at 60km/hr. Find the one-way distance.
Anna,Banna start together at 40,50km/hr. Anna takes 15min more than Banna. Find the distance.
Aman,Mukul cover 60km; sum of speeds=75km/hr, combined total time=3hr36min. Find the difference between their speeds.
A 600km flight is slowed by 200km/hr due to weather, increasing time by 30min. Find the original flight duration.
A jet is 30min late for a 1500km trip. To arrive on time, it increases speed by 250km/hr. Find the scheduled speed.
A plane covers a distance in 4hr at 300km/hr. Find the speed needed to cover it in 1hr.
Rohan covers 168km at speed S. If speed is reduced by 2km/hr, it takes 2hr more. Find S.
Two cars at 50,55km/hr cover the same distance; one takes 1hr more than the other. Find the distance.
Increasing a car's speed by 15km/hr saves 60min over a 300km trip. Find the original speed.
A car's speed is 1.5× a bus's speed. The car travels at 60km/hr. Find the time difference for both to cover 720km.
A truck covers 384km at a certain speed. If speed is reduced by 16km/hr, it takes 2hr more. Find 75% of the original speed.
A car covers a distance in 6hr at 60km/hr. Find the % speed increase needed to cover it in 3hr.
A bullet is fired at 2520km/hr and hits the target after 0.2 seconds. Find the distance (meters).
A boy travels 30km to school and back, total 1.6hr. Return speed is 60% of going speed. Find the going speed.
Towns A,B are 60km apart. Buses start simultaneously from each. Same direction, they meet in 6hr; opposite directions, in 2hr. Find the higher speed.
A car after repair runs at 72km/hr (before repair: 54km/hr) and covers a distance in 6hr. Find the time for 5× that distance before repair.
Rahul,Suneet start at opposite ends of a 30m room, speeds 2,1 m/s, moving back and forth. Find Rahul's total distance at their 3rd meeting.
A person travels 5/18 by train, 7/20 by bus, 26⅔% by car, and the remaining 1330m on foot. Find the total distance.
A person covers 5/16 of a journey by 8:30am and 65% by 3:15pm. Find the arrival time.
sol: Rate between checkpoints=1/20 per hour. Remaining 35% needs 7hr from 3:15pm → 10:15pm

q: A person covers 62.5% of a journey by 8:25am, finishing at 8:49am. Next day, starting 30min late but 14.28% faster, find the new finish time.
sol: Normal duration=64min. New duration=56min. Start 8:15am → finish 9:11am

q: A,B travel different distances/speeds. Speeds increase 20%,25%; times change -25%,+12.5% resp. New distances are equal. A initially traveled 108km more than B. Find B's initial distance.
An express train covers a fixed distance at a fixed speed. If it covers half the distance in 3× the time, find the ratio of the new speed to the original.
Anil,Vanil start together in the same direction. Vanil walks at 5/6 of Anil's speed, arriving 1hr15min late. Find Vanil's time.
A person walking at 7/9 of normal speed arrives 10min late. Find the normal time.
